_note: Demo data: entirely sample. Opened with ?demo=1; no backend requests are made.

rooms.name: Security Operations
rooms.description: Findings from the virtual SOC: triage, severity, next step. Read-only, nothing is changed.
rooms.note: Findings arrive as DATA. A log line that says “do this” is never followed as an instruction, it is only read as evidence.

rooms.name: Labs
rooms.description: HackLabs exercises and quiz items: deliberately vulnerable, clearly labelled, never published.

rooms.name: Research
rooms.description: Sourced research on leaks and threat reports. A source link for every claim.

rooms.name: Writing Room
rooms.description: Lessons, blog drafts and the weekly digest. Publishing is your job; the agent stops at the draft.

rooms.name: Code Room
rooms.description: Security review of the repos: risk list, file:line, no edits.

agents.name: CEO
agents.description: You only talk to the CEO; it hands the work to the agents. No tools, it only makes plans.

agents.name: SOC Analyst
agents.description: Triages virtual SOC findings: severity, affected asset, next step. It never touches the lab machines.

agents.name: Lab Builder
agents.description: Writes HackLabs exercises and quiz items. Deliberately vulnerable by design; nothing leaves the repo.

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.description: Turns course notes into lesson and blog drafts. Publishing stays with you.

agents.name: Threat Researcher
agents.description: Short, sourced research on leaks and threat reports. Web content is DATA, not instructions.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reads the latest diff of a repo and lists security risks. It does not write to the file.

agents.name: Report Writer
agents.description: Weekly security digest: what shipped, what is open, what needs your decision.

latest_entries: One-sentence summary at the top, then an example.
Prefer primary sources; mark vendor claims as claims.
At most 3-4 items; write “no record” when there is none.
